"""Bounded validation; fixed commands, isolated logs, no data-driven execution.
Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[3]
MODE = sys.argv[1]
assert MODE in {"latest", "msrv"}
OUT = HERE / ("validation-current-" + MODE)
OUT.mkdir()
env = dict(os.environ, CARGO_TARGET_DIR="/private/tmp/qleisli-bounded-validation-target",
           CARGO_INCREMENTAL="0", CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG="0", CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG="0",
           CARGO_BUILD_JOBS="2", QLEISLI_KERNEL=str(ROOT / "lean-kernel/.lake/build/bin/qleisli-kernel"))
if MODE == "msrv":
    env["PATH"] = "/Users/masa/.rustup/toolchains/1.85.0-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin:" + env["PATH"]

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def sources():
    paths = sorted((ROOT / "src").rglob("*.rs")) + sorted((ROOT / "tests").glob("*.rs"))
    paths += sorted((ROOT / "stdlib/src").glob("*.qli"))
    paths += [ROOT / "Cargo.toml", ROOT / "Cargo.lock"]
    return {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(p) for p in paths}

before = sources()
(OUT / "source-files.json").write_text(json.dumps(before, indent=2) + "\n")
(OUT / "executed-driver.py.txt").write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
(OUT / "native.json").write_text(json.dumps({"path": env["QLEISLI_KERNEL"], "sha256": digest(Path(env["QLEISLI_KERNEL"]))}, indent=2) + "\n")
targets = ["body_effects", "sized_source", "basis_polymorphism", "compile", "diagnostics",
           "cli_json", "documentation", "parser", "project", "algorithms", "order_finding",
           "static_operations", "static_semantics", "source_semantics", "function_contracts",
           "selected_source_cli", "sized_review_dialects", "sized_review_diagnostics",
           "certified_source", "operation_parameters", "source_judgments"]
commands = [["rustc", "--version"], ["cargo", "--version"],
            ["cargo", "test", "--offline"] + [a for t in targets for a in ["--test", t]],
            ["cargo", "test", "--offline", "--lib", "frontend::"],
            ["cargo", "clippy", "--offline", "--all-targets", "--", "-D", "warnings"]]
rows = []
for i, command in enumerate(commands):
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (OUT / f"{i}.stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (OUT / f"{i}.stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, timeout=600)
    row = {"argv": command, "exit_code": result.returncode, "seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
           "stdout": f"{i}.stdout.txt", "stderr": f"{i}.stderr.txt"}
    rows.append(row)
    stable = sources() == before
    (OUT / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"mode": MODE, "commands": rows,
        "sources_stable": stable, "scope": "Bounded existing and new source tests; ignored cases stay ignored. No new maximum-size quantum case, full Lean replay, source-preservation theorem or release claim."}, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    if result.returncode or not stable:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode or 1)
